# `silk/build/execution`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Deferred storage for a build step's work, using the ordinary fiber execution boundary.

Construction packages the work without running it. The graph runner supplies its resolved
context when the dependencies are complete, then drives the work on a worker fiber.

Import as `Pending` with `import silk.build.execution { Pending }`.

Public declarations: 2.

<a id="Pending.impl.execute"></a>

### Method `execute`

```silk
pub effect fn execute(self: Self, context: C) -> A ! E
```

Supplies the resolved inputs and drives the work to completion, preserving typed failures.
A parked step resumes only after its execution's readiness notification.
